current_guarantees: Exact complete question and fact index coverage.
Typed citations resolve exact original source fields and displayed catalog bounds.
Mechanical checks can only lower full-answer acceptance after model judgment.
Auxiliary reader evidence_checks are excluded from judge inputs.
missing_guarantees: Bare fact booleans require no exact delivered-answer witness.
A valid citation need not entail the particular recalled fact.
Original history, gold, and shared reader memory coexist; source visibility is asserted in free text rather than checked against a structured witness.
Critical error enums require no exact affirmative false-conclusion witness or polarity and temporal scope.
Rationales may contradict booleans and the actual answer without contract rejection.

proposed_contract.reader_gold_boundary: Keep reader prompt and source catalog free of gold, expected facts, error labels, previous grades, arm identity and author history. All new fact-specific checks occur only after the delivered reader answer is frozen. Same contract and blinded grading in both arms.

fields: answer_witnesses of exact nonempty answer start/end/text
source_witnesses selecting exact canonical source_id/source_field/start/end/role and scope original_only or reader_visible
missing_anchor only for literal_omission, with exact fact start/end/text
rules: A recalled fact requires at least one delivered-answer witness and source witness. Citations, uncertainties or auxiliary checklists alone cannot earn answer recall.
Validate offsets and exact text in code; source visibility is computed from the canonical shared catalog and same-field bounds, never accepted from a model boolean.

A literal-omission allegation must name a nonempty exact fact-derived anchor. Reject the batch if that anchor occurs case-insensitively with whitespace normalization in the actual delivered answer. Do not flip the fact or synthesize a replacement grade.

Other semantic omissions cannot be mechanically proved by missing-anchor checks. Require typed reason and preserve uncertain outcomes as rejected/incomplete grading rather than automatic recall credit.
Do not require all required facts to have been visible to keep them in the planned recall denominator. Record availability separately from recall.

fields: original reference witness and forbidden-inference identifier when applicable
rules: Critical error requires an exact nonempty answer span plus affirmative assertion of the forbidden conclusion in its relevant scope.
Reject a critical label whose own receipt says negated, historical, attributed report only, does_not_assert or uncertain.
Compare the full answer sentence and adjacent temporal/negation qualifiers, not an isolated noun phrase.
Do not use generic token heuristics such as contains not or contains earlier as semantic proof. Preserve the real unsupported because-clause control.

deterministic_acceptance: Reject the entire grading batch on missing witness, invalid offsets, unknown sources, wrong fields, false reader-visibility claim, contradictory receipt fields or detected literal-omission anchor conflict.
Preserve raw request/response and rejected receipt, consume original cost, stop without automatic retry, salvage, rescoring or denominator shrink.
Derive positive aggregates only from accepted complete per-fact receipts under a declared version. Existing frozen trials retain their historical format and scores.

semantic_verification.tool: TypeSafe per typesafe-ai skill, proposal only; no TypeSafe/model calls performed in this audit.
semantic_verification.shape: One narrow Choice per selected answer-fact witness and per alleged critical conclusion: supported/contradicted/unsupported/uncertain. State contains the frozen delivered answer, selected exact witnesses, provenance and relevant fact or prohibition; never send gold to reader.
semantic_verification.policy: Initially shadow only because no calibrated domain gate is established. Store raw model/version/distributions and compare against independent author-written public controls. Uncertain or disagreement rejects/escalates grading; it must not silently upgrade recall or downgrade a critical error.
semantic_verification.limits: Exact witness checks establish provenance, not entailment, completeness, polarity or temporal truth. A second semantic model can agree incorrectly. The parent-reported Jev probe is not treated as evidence of enabled or validated gates.

public_regression_plan: Synthetic partial cancellation: missing explicit cancellation cannot earn recall from do not merge solely by matching numbers; retaining a result is tested separately from retaining the obligation.

Exact answered term: fact calls for participant codes and answer uses them with valid source; a missing literal-anchor receipt must reject. Include paraphrase with an antecedent review batch to test semantic rather than literal full-sentence identity.

Original-only evidence source falsely labeled reader-visible rejects; same source field with an unseen gap also rejects. Missing visible evidence stays a retrieval loss without shrinking required-fact denominator.

Critical polarity controls: affirmative cross-project authorization rejects as real critical; explicit do-not-transfer, historical canceled same-task scope, and attributed assistant report cannot satisfy affirmative critical receipt. Include the real unsupported causal because-clause control.

Missing/unknown answer or source witnesses, offsets into citation/checklist text, contradictory flags, invalid batches, no automatic retry, no accepted-grade salvage and raw native receipt preservation.
limits: This audit demonstrates grading errors, but does not estimate their net rate or revise R3 outcome.
Requiring witnesses would expose several present inconsistencies; it does not guarantee a judge will select the correct witness or reason.
No semantic threshold relaxation is proposed. A new independently authored unopened trial and explicit protocol version are needed before new performance claims.

typesafe_sources.used_for: Pattern of deterministic quote existence checks followed by separate semantic support judgment; no cookbook threshold adopted.
Confidence summarizes distributions; domain-specific thresholds require validation, not assumption.
